assessments.reasoning: The W3C dated Recommendation URL and document heading identify XML 1.0 Fifth Edition of 26 November 2008. The independently downloaded full response SHA-256 matches the registered source revision. Section 2.10 states the general obligation and validating-processor addition. Section 2.11 applies normalization before parsing. The obligation concerns characters as processed according to XML input rules. The validating processor's additional duty is separable. Both sections govern an XML processor and its application boundary in the named edition. End-of-line normalization prevents preservation of raw line-ending bytes in some cases. The claim retains that qualification.

limitations: The source imposes separate input normalization rules. An additional obligation to identify white space in element content applies to validating processors.
